description: Give a task in plain English and get back the services that can perform it: their price, their input and output schema, what they cost in total, which are essential and which are optional, and the capabilities you asked for that NO service provides. Free, and it never invokes anything.

budget_usd.description: The most you are willing to spend, in USD. The Gateway reports whether the matched services fit inside it. It never spends.

capabilities_required.description: The capabilities you need. When you give this list it IS the requirement set and the Gateway does not second-guess it.

limit.description: How many matches to return. Maximum 25.

protocol_preference.description: Preferred protocols (for example 'x402'). Recorded and echoed.

task.description: What you want to do, in your own words. The Gateway derives the capability requirements from it.

name: discover_capabilities

alternatives.description: Other services that cover the same requirement.

budget_shortfall_usd.description: How much over the budget the matches are, when they are.

budget_usd.description: The budget that was asked for.

catalogue.description: Which catalogue artefact answered, its sha256 and its service count.

confidence.description: 'high' only when every match carries a measured price and measured latency and nothing is unmet; otherwise 'low'.

confidence_reason.description: Why the confidence is what it is.

estimated_total_cost_reason.description: Why the total is what it is.

estimated_total_cost_usd.description: The sum of the matched prices, or null when at least one price is unknown. Never an estimate.

matches.description: The catalogue services that can perform the task.

matches_truncated.description: True when more services matched than the limit allowed.

missing_capabilities.description: The capabilities the task needs that NO catalogue service provides. Empty when everything the task needs is covered.

nearest_services.description: The catalogue services that came closest.

notes.description: Anything the caller should know about this answer.

recommend_none_reason.description: Why nothing is recommended, when nothing is.

required_capabilities.description: The capabilities the Gateway derived from the task.

required_capabilities_source.description: Where the requirements came from: 'task', 'capabilities_required' or 'none'.

title: Discover Capabilities
